scope: All production C# sources, excluding build output; original system partial files included. Structural evidence, not arbitrary-provider or whole-runtime acceptance.

review.criterion: Systems use capability contracts where declared, not hard-coded OilCo component lookup.
review.runtime_queries_and_casts: Zero native runtime component queries/type branches across395 production C# files;33 native runtime declarations and1397 typed query sites inventoried. No dynamic gameplay or runtime GetType-vs-native-type selection found.
review.system_scope: Fourteen actual GameSystem implementations across twenty declaration/partial source files. Module registrations and other helpers sharing these files are not mistaken for system decisions.
review.codec_identity_checks: Twenty native typeof sites preserve immutable metadata-to-original-runtime/schema ownership. ConstructionBindings: Constructible/Site metadata codec identity; ExplorationModule: undeclared native exploration binding; IncidentBindings: incident/signal bindings; IncidentPropagationContent: actual emitter binding; inventory/network/utility signal and gate bindings: schema/actual original runtime admission; NetworkPortsBindings: original Ports codec; recurring bindings/WorkRecurringPlans: original schedule codec8 admission. They do not query native runtime component slots or select gameplay by runtime class.
review.service_boundary: World/container/work/line/logistics services remain their original owners; helper access is not a new independent provider model. Tile-native geometry exists only in explicitly selected tile content/module; generic movement/work/production systems consume IMotion/IWorker/ITransformer/IInventory/ILineSimulation and related capabilities.
review.repair: RecurringPlanContracts.ReadSchedule now selects observed reusable metadata admission by IRecurringActivitySourceDefinition, not source is RecurringActivitySource. Original guard, source, schedule/history owner and codec8 remain.
review.limits: Structural acceptance plus representative physical cross-contract runtime proof; not all-system runtime, arbitrary-provider correctness/purity, private CLR sandbox, global regression or complete P2/P1-P12.
